review_checks: Identity screening found no Emscher, PHOENIX See or Dortmund identity in the Atlas data and route inventory. Count two bounded projects and one municipality, with no historical acquisition docket reused.

Sixteen official German HTML bodies or stated segments were inspected November 22. The exact English articles are authored and AI self-reviewed, not independently language-reviewed or additional translated-reading identities.
Three articles contain 631, 621 and 620 body words, eighteen sections and twelve chronology events. Five sections per article bind sources; each final section is a labelled editorial evidence test.

AKE is the named 51 km route and three pumps, not the regional restoration umbrella. Total pipe length differs; century-long design life is not observed life. Investment is scoped to the canal and pumps.

The 2024 retrospective's first operation in 2018 differs from the Gelsenkirchen page's September 2019 completion. The latter body is German despite its /en/ URL. Its inconsistent capacity table is not used.
April 2021 Oberhausen tests concern six of ten pumps, not whole-system acceptance. Later end-2021 operation does not backdate those tests or prove full ecological recovery.
January 2026 river monitoring retains 2024 oxygen-period limits, continuing chemical-status problems and separate March 2023 mine-water and April 2025 treatment interventions.

PHOENIX See is the former Phoenix Ost redevelopment, not Phoenix West. Filling began October 1, 2010 and public opening is retained at May 2011 precision. The lake and larger development areas differ.
The lake environmental page explicitly summarizes the 2021 water year. Extreme river diversion is not ordinary continuous supply; no new 2026 water-quality result is inferred.

Accessibility provisions are a published account, not a live route or toilet inspection. The path notice was published October 8, gives October 7 as the start and retains its first-quarter 2027 target.
Dialogue history ends in the listed August 2021 event; it is not a current meeting calendar or proof all complaints were resolved. Cancelled March 2020 plans are not represented as a held meeting.
Dortmund's September 2026 report describes 2025, with funding for construction or modernization separate from completed new homes. The 170 statistical subdistricts are analytical units.

March heat modelling and the undated map explanation establish planning boundaries, not current adoption, connected share or address-specific service. The overview's warning and stale legal FAQs are excluded from individual advice.

Initial flood-map coverage is limited to two catchments; river flooding differs from surface runoff. The maps themselves were not queried. The October 9 waste article is distinct from the October 7 press listing; supplier savings are not observed municipal performance.

The EGLV measurement blog timed out, two application.dortmund.de pages returned 502 and the October 7 waste press URL returned only navigation. Other official canonical bodies supplied the selected evidence without bypassing access controls. Linked PDFs, maps, films, statutes, forms and live services were not inspected.
